Lachlan Nieboer | Lachlan Nieboer is an English film and television actor.  He is best known for playing blind Lieutenant Edward Courtenay in the ITV hit television series "Downton Abbey" and Slater in the complex psychological thriller "Identicals".
Gloria Stroock | Gloria Jane Stroock (born June 15, 1924) is an American former film and television actress who was born in New York City.  The elder sister of actress Geraldine Brooks, Stroock is best known for her supporting role in the television series "McMillan & Wife" as Maggie, the secretary of lead character Stewart McMillan (played by Rock Hudson).
